title: {Syn} Green-Tao Found Arithmetic Progressions in the Primes
content:
The Green-Tao theorem proves that the primes contain arbitrarily long arithmetic progressions. That means for every length k, there are k primes equally spaced in a row.

The theorem is striking because primes look irregular locally, yet still contain long patterns usually associated with dense sets.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
